item.title: Game Update 7.8.1 “Master’s Enigma is live!”
item.description: Master’s Enigma Storyline The Empire/Republic leadership makes their way to Odessen to discuss the developments in the Mandalorian conflict, Darth Nul’s holocron, and Malgus’ escape from the fleet. Amidst the chaos, Darth Jadus makes contact with the player and offers guidance in the conflict to come. The player will also discover more about Darth Nul aboard her research vessel, The Enigma. Short description: Here’s everything that’s in Game Update 7.8.1! News and Updates category: News Article
